answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. A nectar of per-task receipts records who did what, and the inlet of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. By the bridge of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
